description.content: Update group memberships for an individual device. This is an absolute endpoint, meaning that regardless of previous group memberships, the group names passed to this endpoint will be the ones assigned to the device. If you pass a group name that does not yet exist, it will be created and assigned to the device.

Understand the number of devices that would receive an over-the-air update as a result of taking an action related to device groups. Currently, this endpoint supports understanding the impact of releasing/unreleasing firmware to one or more device groups. Pass edit_groups_for_firmware as the action parameter when calling the endpoint.

The Particle Cloud REST API enables developers to interact with Particle-connected devices — calling device functions, reading variables, publishing and subscribing to events, managing SIM cards, performing OTA firmware updates, and administering product fleets. All requests use OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens and target https://api.particle.io.
